gen-dafont-existence-general-sans: General Sans keeps its line smooth and its x-height full. Existence is the opposite temperament, industrial and sharp, with wide round counters and terminals cut short, while the sans-serif body just flows.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-gentium-plus: Marker-tip letters, friendly and chunky, set against a classic serif with generously open c shapes. Chubbo stays smooth while Gentium Plus adds polish.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-gowun-batang: Chubbo draws its casual, marker-tipped letters with diagonals as heavy as the uprights, and Gowun Batang sits beside it as a refined, literary serif. Playful meets bookish, and neither crowds the other.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-habibi: Habibi reads as a traditional, editorial serif, with a clear channel leading into every round letter. Chubbo's flat, marker-drawn strokes make a friendly counterpoint.
gen-eater-satoshi: Eater looks dark and aggressive, with tempered strokes that never thin to hairlines. Satoshi, a plain sans with a soaring x-height and open e, makes extended reading feel approachable.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: New Title is bold and modern, its tall lowercase locked together like links in a fine chain. And Hedvig Letters Serif, a text serif with open curves and medium contrast, answers with sturdy authority.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab reads in a refined, traditional way, with robust downstrokes, slender turns and an open e channel that suits screens. New Title earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Wide, bold, commanding Goldman has round forms like open parentheses and a big lowercase. And Pilcrow Rounded, a plain sans with tight spacing and big counters, reads warm and neutral.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-hind: Paprika is commanding and expressive, its lowercase filling the line like capitals. Hind's sans-serif steadiness, with c ends that never curl inward, is the quieter strength.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans reads sturdy and large, its tall lowercase and clearly open e making words feel solid. Revalia adds bold, widely spaced expression above.
